title: Simulation of heavy metal release from calcium arsenic residue under atmospheric and thermal weathering: implications for waste safety management
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3506-3520
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00455A, Paper
Xiaolong Zhao, Ying Du, Guangli Wang, Zhiying Zhao, Yaguang Du, Dongyun Du
Calcium arsenic residue (CAR), generated during nonferrous metal smelting and acidic wastewater treatment, pose significant environmental risks due to its instability under atmospheric exposure.
